user.description: Connect to the Hanchu IESS3 cloud portal.

data.include_sn_in_name: Include serial number in device name

data_description.inverter_sn: Found on the inverter label, e.g. H03XXXXXXXXXX. Leave blank for battery-only systems.
data_description.battery_sn: Found on the battery rack label, e.g. B0BXXXXXXXXXX. Required if no inverter serial number is entered.
data_description.include_sn_in_name: When enabled, devices are named 'Hanchu Inverter H03...' instead of 'Hanchu Inverter'. Useful if you have multiple inverters.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Hanchu ESS
reauth_confirm.description: Your Hanchu password was rejected. Enter the current password for {username}.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check your credentials and serial number.
error.missing_serial: Enter an inverter serial number, a battery serial number, or both.

data_description.power_interval: How often to poll the inverter for live power data. Minimum 10 s, default 30 s.
data_description.battery_interval: How often to poll the battery rack for data. Minimum 10 s, default 60 s.
